title: Warburg Mulls $1 Billion Sale of London Insurance Broker McGill
summary: Warburg Pincus has held early talks with potential advisers about a sale of London insurance broker McGill and Partners, which could be valued around $1 billion.

title: Flora Food Group sale could spread $10bn KKR's way
summary: KKR is working with investment banks on a possible sale of Flora Food Group (formerly Upfield) at up to $10bn, the FT reported; a 2025 sale attempt to ADIA collapsed on price.

title: Affinity Is Said to Explore Selling Stake in Plaza Premium Group
summary: Affinity Equity Partners is exploring a sale of its stake in Hong Kong airport-lounge and hospitality firm Plaza Premium Group, Bloomberg reported.

title: Warburg Said to Eye $2.5 Billion-Plus Sale of Auto Lender Exeter
summary: Warburg Pincus is in the early stages of weighing a sale of US subprime auto lender Exeter Finance that could fetch $2.5bn-$3bn, and is also considering an IPO; no final decision has been made, per Bloomberg.

title: TPG, Leonard Green Explore Sale of McIlroy-Backed Troon Golf
summary: TPG and Leonard Green are exploring a sale of Troon, one of the largest US golf course operators, which could be valued at more than $2bn; no final decision has been made, per Bloomberg.

title: KKR explores $10 billion sale of Flora Food Group
summary: KKR is working with bankers on a potential sale of Flora Food Group (formerly Upfield) at about a $10bn valuation, per the Financial Times; no final decision has been made.

title: Warburg mulls $1 billion sale of London insurance broker McGill
summary: Warburg Pincus held preliminary talks with advisers on a possible sale of specialty (re)insurance broker McGill and Partners that could value it above $1bn.

title: Escape Plan raises USD 25 Mn in Series A led by Jungle Ventures
summary: Indian travel products brand Escape Plan raised $25m in a Series A led by Jungle Ventures, with Fireside Ventures and IndiGo Ventures participating.

title: KKR, CVC said to bid for TowerBrook-owned lender Premium Credit
summary: KKR and CVC are reportedly among initial bidders for UK premium finance lender Premium Credit, which TowerBrook is exploring selling for more than £1bn.

title: KKR said in talks to sell BMC Helix to Montagu for $900 million
summary: KKR was reported to be in exclusive talks to sell IT service-management software firm BMC Helix to Montagu for about $900m.

title: Jungle Ventures co-leads USD 5.1 million seed round in Enerzolve Smart Technologies
summary: Jungle Ventures co-led a $5.1m seed round with Kae Capital in Indian semiconductor-based energy solutions startup Enerzolve.

title: Navis Explores Sale of Stake in Nuts and Snacks Firm Dan-D Foods
summary: Navis Capital Partners is exploring a sale of its majority stake in Dan-D Foods, a nuts and snacks maker with sourcing and processing in Vietnam; later reports said an adviser has been hired.

title: Navis Capital partners PEP Gateway to buy NZ's Mainland Poultry
summary: Navis Capital Partners has partnered with an affiliate of Pacific Equity Partners to acquire New Zealand egg producer Mainland Poultry through a continuation vehicle structure.

title: KKR's MYOB in focus as thirsty dealmakers circle
summary: Industry sources expect KKR to start laying groundwork for an exit from Australian accounting software firm MYOB this year, with a trade sale more likely than an ASX listing; a source close to KKR says there are no imminent exit plans.

title: Brookfield to Acquire Fosber
summary: Brookfield's private equity arm agreed to carve out packaging-machinery maker Fosber at about $900m, with BBU investing about $170m via Brookfield Capital Partners.

title: KKR and Taiyo Holdings Agree to Privatization to Accelerate Long Term Growth
summary: KKR agreed to take Japan's Taiyo Holdings private via a JPY 4,750-per-share tender offer backed by its board and top shareholder Oasis.

title: Escape Plan Raises USD 25 Mn in Series A Led by Jungle Ventures
summary: Escape Plan raised a $25m Series A led by Jungle Ventures, with Fireside Ventures and IndiGo Ventures participating.

title: Jungle Ventures Co-leads USD 5.1 Million Seed Round In Enerzolve Smart Technologies
summary: Jungle Ventures co-led a $5.1m seed round in Indian deeptech startup Enerzolve Smart Technologies alongside Kae Capital.
